title: Find out what type of permit you need for medical waste

paragraphs: You fall under regulations if you generate a certain amount of medical waste each month or treat waste onsite.

To see if your business is regulated by the Hazardous Materials and Waste Program, calculate how much medical waste your business makes each month. Also, think about whether you treat waste onsite or handle waste for others.
We'll work with you on the steps to get the right permits or registration.

sections.heading: If you: › Create less than 200 pounds of medical waste monthly
paragraphs: Register as a Small Quality Generator (SQG)

sections.heading: If you: › Create more than 200 pounds of medical waste monthly for 12 months
paragraphs: Get a Large Quality Generator (LGQ) permit

sections.heading: If you: › Treat medical waste onsite
If you: › Collect and arrange for the disposal of small amounts of daily medical waste
paragraphs: Get a Common Storage Facility (CSF) permit

sections.heading: If you: › Transport your own small amount of medical waste to a transfer station or common storage facility
paragraphs: Get a Limited Quantity Hauling Exemption (LQHE) permit
You'll be limited to no more than 20 pounds per week. You cannot transport more than 20 pounds at a time.

sections.heading: What to do
paragraphs: Register or get your medical waste permit through the Hazardous Materials and Waste Program .
